_note: Generated by results/utils/build_supplementary.py directly from eval/llm/run_openai.py and eval/llm/run_ollama.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script instead.

decoding._comment: Identical for every model, dataset and prompting condition. Greedy decoding under a fixed seed makes variation across the nine conditions attributable to the prompt rather than to sampling.

closed_source._comment: Pinned to a dated snapshot rather than the moving alias, so the run is reproducible against a fixed backend.

open_weight._comment: num_ctx is set explicitly because Ollama's default silently truncates an over-long prompt. It bounds the context for the open-weight models regardless of the checkpoint's own limit.

max_output_tokens._comment: Per dataset and protocol, uniform across the three prompt groups, sized to roughly five times the measured 99th percentile of generation length. Truncation is silent and clips the longest generations first, which would bias the surviving sample toward shorter and easier instances.

prompting_conditions._comment: Three prompt groups crossed with three elicitation protocols. Sentiment Polarity realises twelve conditions rather than nine: its True/False recast queries each sentence twice, counterbalanced over the asserted polarity.
